title: Vilnius Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi cathedral and detached mapped bell tower:six tapered west portico columns with real open bays,recessed closed central door,selected facade niches/figures,triangular pediment and three roof figures/cross,long gray nave roof,open north/south galleries,two rear domed chapels/lanterns,and round-base/faceted bell tower with open belfry,clock fields and dark spire. Exact relief/sculpture,full interiors,adjacent palace,square monuments and certified walking excluded.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained exact-QID way4870323 and 74 current cathedral/bell controls, including individual columns. Mapped spacing and signed west portico retained without overall rescaling.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Current cathedral parent is approximately73x60m including lateral galleries/chapels;the detached14.3m bell base sits about70m west and21m south of the cathedral anchor. Current parts give20m main roof/front roof/chapel domes,14m galleries,16m front columns,17m chapel bodies,24m chapel lanterns and25m front cross. Bell parts give15m round base,24m lower faceted stage,36m belfry,50m clock/upper roof control,57m spire and59m finial. Internal stage roles are photo-led estimates:16.8m nave eave,16..17m front entablature,17..20m pediment,17..20m chapel domes and19.8..24m lanterns;bell belfry24..36m,clock stage36..43m,spire43..57m. Column taper,capitals,openings,selected figures/relief fields and thresholds remain approximate;map heights are not a survey.
